$comment: Locale residue check (scripts/lib/residue.ts; run by scripts/validate-content.ts and scripts/check-locale-residue.ts; docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md §1b). Words that must not reach a locale's readers because they belong to another locale's audience. English refocus (owner, 23 October 2026): the English site is for the US, the UK, Canada and Australia (notes: Ireland, New Zealand); Dutch, Belgian, German and EU reader framing leaves it and is saved for the Dutch site. Levels: error = a term that never belongs on this locale (no marker exempts it; only allowFiles); frame = reader framing ("in the EU", "European Union", euro amounts) that may stay only as evidence or history, with the marker; warn = a name that may stay as evidence (EU, EMA, EPAR, CHMP, Europe), reported for a look and silenced by the marker. The marker is {/* residue-ok: <why> */} in MDX or # residue-ok: <why> in YAML frontmatter, on the line before the text or at the end of the same line (inside a table row: at the end of the row). While STRICT_RESIDUE (scripts/lib/residue.ts) is false every hit is a warning; then error and frame hits are errors. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions; flags default to "iu" (case-insensitive), "u" makes one case-sensitive. allowFiles: pages (paths under src/content/pages/<locale>/, without .mdx) where the listed error/frame patterns are allowed (the publisher line). allowStrings: i18n or data strings (file, key regex) where the listed patterns are allowed; JSON has no comments, so this is the JSON form of the marker. A file that ends in / covers every file in that folder. allowPhrases: proper names that contain a pattern but are not reader framing (a literature database, a company's legal name), skipped in every scan, the built pages included.
